description: Minimal, hash-bound Student identity (plan §19). Every field is mandatory; nothing is inferred. Missing/placeholder fields raise instead of guessing.

architecture_family.semantics: network family, e.g. RMT16 / GTrXL128 / SLOWGRU

checkpoint_format.semantics: one of checkpoint_codec format families (CC2_PKL / ORBAX_TRAIN_STATE / ORBAX_NESTED_PARAMS / BAKEOFF_PKL / PHASE4A_PKL)

global_step.semantics: optimizer/global step recorded in the checkpoint manifest; >= 0

total_env_steps.semantics: total environment steps the candidate was trained for; >= 0

params_sha256.semantics: 64-hex sha256 over the params pytree leaves (CC2 algorithm: sha256 of np.ascontiguousarray(np.asarray(leaf)).tobytes() per jax.tree_util.tree_leaves, in leaf order)

source_commit.semantics: training-source identity binding; for CC2 candidates the SHA-bound driver source, e.g. src-sha256:453bd1ec…

observation_shape.semantics: obs contract, e.g. [8335] = 8268 MiniCraftaxTrain + 67 multitask embedding

action_count.semantics: discrete action count; cross-verified against craftax len(Action)==43

memory_spec_hash.semantics: MemorySpec.spec_hash(); empty string only pre-binding, otherwise 64-hex

extras.semantics: non-binding metadata only; never participates in the identity hash

validation_rules: text fields non-empty and free of placeholders (PENDING*/UNKNOWN/TODO/NONE/N/A) -> raise
identity_hash_algorithm: sha256 over canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators ','/':', ensure_ascii=False) of all fields except extras
placeholder_policy: NEVER guess; a gap is a hard error (fail closed)
